title: 23 Mexico 2544: Mexico: Weekly Political Blotter, September 11-15
doc_notes: This is a weekly political blotter from the U.S. Embassy in Mexico that includes a brief report on a congressional hearing regarding alleged alien remains.

encounters.summary: Mexican journalist Jaime Maussan presented two alleged alien corpses to the Mexican Congress during a hearing on unidentified aerial phenomena.
encounters.entity_appearance: small, desiccated humanoid figure with a large head and three-fingered hands
